**Synopsis:**
London Climate Week (8th edition) coincided with a record June heatwave, underlining climate urgency ahead of COP31 (Turkey, November). Key themes: heat resilience, adaptation financing (£11bn/year needed for UK alone), fossil fuel windfall taxes, and corporate decarbonisation. Global heat-related deaths up 23% since the 1990s to ~546,000/year. UK's Climate Change Committee warns heat deaths could exceed 10,000/year by 2050. Speakers from Guterres to Ed Miliband called for accelerated climate action.
